passives.name: Absorb
passives.description: Taking magic damage from an enemy champion grants a Steadfast stack for 7s (max 10, at most one gain per second). Getting hit while stunned or rooted grants 3 stacks instead (stand-in for the immobilize bonus).
passives.if: dtype == 'magic' and t_champion and not t_self

passives.name: Dissipate
passives.description: While at 10 Steadfast stacks, gain 30 magic resist and 10% move speed.
